summary: Pin invalid body refusal and a reachable malformed history-row fixture

replay.detail: Authored controls only; no replay change.

compatibility.detail: The wide-body, omission count, cursor advancement, retained-item order, positive reachability and read-only assertions remain. A release-note wording correction avoids a slash-joined phrase matching the public identity scanner; the scanner and its allowlist are unchanged.

manual.detail: No live data, policy, grant or alert action.

recovery.detail: These corrected controls require their own hosted run; no earlier result or native acceptance transfers.
